subtitle: Find your next collaborator
promotionalText: Find photographers, models, stylists and other creatives whose work fits yours, see who's into what you make, and make something together.
description:
Melange is where creative people find their next collaboration.

A photographer needs a model. A model needs a stylist. A filmmaker needs a whole crew. On Melange you find people whose work fits yours, see who's into what you make, and make something together.

DISCOVER
Swipe through creatives and projects near you: photographers, models, makeup artists, stylists, hair, videographers, directors, musicians and more. Melange learns your taste from the work you make and like.

HEARTS
Heart someone's work and they find out it was you. When someone hearts yours, you can write back right away.

EVENTS
Photo walks, shoot nights, open calls. Everyone going shares a chat before, and afterwards the photos are private to the people who were there. You can quietly heart anyone you met; they only find out if they hearted you too.

CREDITS
Post what you made and credit everyone on it. Explore is the wall of what your scene is making.

SAFETY
Every account is 18+. Block or report any person, post or message; a person reads every report. Your data is locked to your account, and you can delete everything from inside the app.

Starting around USC, UCSD and LA.
